name: video
description: Motion-graphics video kit: a HyperFrames-compatible composition that plays in the browser with player controls and renders to MP4 with `npx prosicht render`. index.html is the entry point; css/, js/ and assets/ hold everything it loads. Core files are refreshed by `prosicht update`; starter files are written once by `prosicht init` and then belong to the film. `prosicht publish` uploads index.html, css/, js/ and assets/ only.
